headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: O’Brien invokes Gandhi amid calls for protests against EC.
Telangana Governor, CM pay tributes to Mahatma Gandhi at Bapu Ghat in Hyderabad.
BJP tells Karnataka Chief Minister prove Form 7 allegations or quit.
Trump says Iran link possible as flydubai co-pilot is transferred to UAE.
HC directs Assembly Speaker to decide  on disqualification of MLA Mani C. Kappan.
bullets_ur: O'Brien ne Gandhi ka hawala diya, EC ke khilaf ehtijaj ki appeal ke darmiyan
Telangana Governor aur CM ne Hyderabad ke Bapu Ghat par Mahatma Gandhi ko khiraj-e-tahseen pesh kiya
BJP ne Karnataka CM se kaha: Form 7 ke ilzamat sabit karein warna istifa dein
Trump ne kaha: Iran link mumkin, flydubai co-pilot ko UAE transfer kiya gaya
HC ne Assembly Speaker ko MLA Mani C. Kappan ki disqualification par faisla karne ka hukm diya
